_comment: All Google Play IDs live here. Fill in the values from Play Console. Empty IDs are skipped safely.

play_games._game_id_note: Numeric Project ID from Play Console > Play Games Services > Configuration. Also put it into the Android export preset option godot_play_game_services/game_id.
play_games._leaderboards_note: Create two leaderboards in Play Console (Play Games Services > Leaderboards): 'Max stage' (integer, higher is better) and 'Rift Raid' (integer, higher is better; score = tier*100 + percent, shown in game as Tier X.YY). Play Games keeps daily, weekly and all-time spans for every leaderboard automatically; the weekly span resets every Sunday ~00:00 PT. Paste the IDs (CgkI...) here.
